thread:
oncall-bot: paging: SRE on-call needed for high error rate from inference cluster in us-west-2a — 5xx uplink errors from nv-gpu nodes. See alert: https://sentry.example/alerts/1801234567 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: alert details: 5xx spike starting 03:12 UTC, p50 latency 200ms -> 1.8s, p95 tokens/sec drop; autoscaler not adding nodes in AZ 'a'
sre_ana: I'm on it, will triage. grabbing logs and checking ENI counts.
eng_matt: fyi I saw increased ENI attach failures earlier in the day in us-west-2a, possible AZ ENI throttling or host-level degradation.
runtime_zoe: confirming inference runtime reports repeated connection resets to gpu-hosts in us-west-2a. KV cache misses spiked.
sre_ana: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep us-west-2a` shows a few nodes NotReady and several pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
eng_matt: I ran `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2a Name=status,Values=available` — ENI available count low vs baseline; also saw Throttling in cloudtrail for AttachNetworkInterface.
sre_ana: hypothesis: partial AZ network control plane issues causing ENI ops to fail, resulting in nodes flapping and NLB health checks failing. mounting: need to fail traffic gracefully to other AZs and adjust routing to preserve hosted API responses.
incident-bot: declared P1 incident: single-AZ network impairment affecting inference GPU nodes. Impact: hosted API request errors and Dedicated pools in us-west-2a degraded. Pagerduty: routed to SRE on-call and Eng Runtime.
sre_ana: immediate mitigation plan:
1) engage routing handoff — shift model routing away from us-west-2a
2) scale up cross-AZ capacity in us-west-2b/c and eu-west-1 for time-critical workloads
3) enable model-fallback to smaller/CPU-compatible variant for best-effort continuity
4) rate-limit new requests to protect backlog and reduce cascading failures
5) notify affected customers (Support to own comms)

runtime_zoe: I can flip routing policy for model family `redwood-gen` at the control plane to set weight us-west-2a:0, us-west-2b:70, us-west-2c:30. Doing a canary change to route 10% first.
eng_matt: also recommend updating NLB target groups to remove unhealthy targets in us-west-2a to avoid hanging connections. I'll run that.
support_jay: prepping customer impact list — Dedicated customers with pinned capacity in us-west-2a will see degraded throughput; Hosted API customers might see increased latency or 503s for affected models. Drafting message to customers now.
sre_ana: execute steps — runtime_zoe roll canary now, eng_matt remove targets, I will maintain watch on node flapping and coordinate cross-AZ scale-up.
runtime_zoe: canary flip started at 03:25 UTC. Router config:
```
- redwood-gen: { us-west-2a: 90 -> 10 }
- fallback: enable model-variant small-gen
```
Canary logs: 10% traffic shows normal latencies to us-west-2b nodes.
eng_matt: removed 14 targets from us-west-2a target group, issued `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes` to deregister unhealthy. NLB connection draining 60s.
sre_ana: scaling note: requesting +4 inference nodes in us-west-2b and +2 in us-west-2c via autoscale override. Executed.
incident-bot: autoscale override request accepted; new instances provisioning. ETA ~7m.
support_jay: customer comms sent to 3 Dedicated customers in us-west-2a (internal tracking ticket ids: CST-2248, CST-2251, CST-2256). Message: short outage notice, mitigation steps, ETA for full restoration TBD.
eng_matt: CloudTrail shows `AttachNetworkInterface` throttling errors from 02:58 -> 03:18 UTC and then intermittent from 03:22 -> present. Opening ticket with AWS support (case 1234567890).
sre_ana: on-call handoff at 04:00 UTC will go to oncoming oncall (eng_matt will take). I will remain in thread for knowledge transfer until then.
eng_matt: taking handoff early, acknowledged. I'll continue tracking AWS case and routing.
runtime_zoe: increased cache drop-initialization on new nodes; we're pre-warming KV cache for critical models to reduce cold-starts. Script snippet:
```
for model in redwood-gen small-gen; do
  curl -X POST https://prewarm.api/internal/prefetch -d '{"model": "$model", "prompt": "prewarm"}'
done
```
Prewarm started.
sre_ana: metrics update at 03:40 UTC — p95 latency back down from 1.8s to 420ms for canaried traffic; overall 5xx rate reduced by 60%. Nodes in us-west-2b scaled to expected capacity. us-west-2a still showing 20% of targets unhealthy.
support_jay: update sent to customers: we have partial recovery via cross-AZ routing, continued mitigation ongoing, next update in 30m.
eng_matt: AWS replied: investigating ENI control plane throttling in us-west-2a, recommended to avoid new ENI attach/detach for 30 mins while they remediate. Case number updated.
sre_ana: plan adjusted — avoid adding more nodes in us-west-2a, maintain weights at us-west-2a:0 for now. Will keep canary and then full cutover if stable.
incident-bot: action item created: ACTION-180123-A — 'maintain weight 0 for us-west-2a for redwood-gen until AWS clears ENI throttling' assigned to eng_matt.
eng_matt: initiated full redirect at 03:52 UTC: us-west-2a:0 -> us-west-2b:60 us-west-2c:40. Confirming no significant error increase.
runtime_zoe: verifying model fallbacks: small-gen fallback active for pinned-dedicated pools that cannot be routed cross-AZ; added brief notice to API response header `X-Inference-Fallback: small-gen` for auditing.
sre_ana: monitoring: running `pgrep -f inference-runtime` logs show no new CrashLoopBackOffs after nodes removed; ENI ops remain limited.
support_jay: sent all-customer digest at 04:05 UTC with mitigation summary and link to status page https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1801234567.
eng_matt: AWS escalated to internal networking team, indicated expected full resolution in ~45-90 minutes.
incident-bot: next update scheduled in 30m. If AWS confirms, we will plan restore traffic to us-west-2a slowly and run canary.
sre_ana: before restore, we need green on AttachNetworkInterface ops and stable NLB target health for 15m.
eng_matt: AWS updated case: control plane repair in progress; recommend reattaching ENIs after 05:30 UTC. I'll coordinate reintroduction and post-restore healthcheck runbook.
runtime_zoe: prepping rollback steps if routing back causes errors: script to set us-west-2a weight back to 0 and spin up additional cross-AZ capacity.
sre_ana: handoff complete, leaving oncall to eng_matt at 04:00 UTC. eng_matt — you own until cleared.
eng_matt: acknowledged. I'll post resolution note when AWS clears and when we restore. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: incident status: Mitigated (traffic routed away, autoscale prewarm done) — P1 remains open while AWS investigates.
support_jay: logging postmortem ticket PM-180123, will start collecting timelines and customer impact metrics once incident closed.
eng_matt: final note before leaving thread: Dedicated customers with pinned us-west-2a capacity — offered temporary cross-AZ migration guidance and credits. Documented in CST tickets.
incident-bot: thread archived to incident workspace when resolved.
